rows.en: What!? You're… If I remember right…
U6, Marie Hanamura… A language genius who knows 39 countries' languages inside out, and a code-breaking expert.
Oh, stop it… Daisaku. Putting it like that is embarrassing.
39 countries!? Well, I'll be… Even the FBI doesn't have a special agent like that.

By the way, Daisaku…

what on earth happened? There must be some reason you two came all the way here, right?

Yes.

BF stole our code-breaking machine.
What!? The code-breaking machine?
The code-breaking team used that machine to decode the coded radio messages sent from Unicorn branches all over the world.

Then…

if it's in BF's hands, Unicorn's security is completely wide open?
Yes, we can't use radio contact at all! There's a high chance BF would hear everything…
That's why we came here in person.
I see… That's a serious situation.
What about Giant Robo? Are Unicorn branches all over the world helpless against BF?
Well…
Giant Robo was attacked by the mollusk kaiju Ikagerasu, and its arm was melted by the dissolving fluid it sprays from its mouth.

It can't sortie for a while because of the repairs!

What's more, BF has joined forces with another evil organization and is holed up in a TDF facility with the code-breaking machine. And Minami, U3, is a hostage too…
What? Another evil organization!? Shocker?
No… Since they manipulate other dimensions freely, we think it may be the space crime organization Makuu…

All right… If we can't use the radio, I'll go contact the TDF directly!

[HERO2], you guys contact Retsu.

All right… If we can't use the radio, I'll go contact the TDF directly!

[HERO2], you guys contact Retsu.
No need for that! We've picked up on Makuu's movements on our end too.
All right, it's Marie, right? You stay here and wait for word. Daisaku, let's go!
Okay!

Be careful, Daisaku…

And don't forget! The password: "What's Napoleon's trump card?"
The <c2>15 of Diamonds</c>!
Hunter Killer… How goes the operation to annihilate the international secret police organization, the Unicorn Agency?

Sir…

We have seized the code-breaking machine from Unicorn's Japan Branch and are hurrying to confirm the locations of Unicorn's branches around the world.
Mm… Strike Earth's international secret police organization before the Galactic Union Police make their move!
Yes, sir…
The Security Team has just arrived! We'll handle seizing the related facilities…

Be careful!

Makuu freely manipulates something called Makuu Space, a kind of black hole! If you get dragged in, you won't be able to move!

Be careful!

Makuu freely manipulates something called Makuu Space, a kind of black hole! If you get dragged in, you won't be able to move!
Understood!
Jiro!?
Jiro!?
I heard about the code-breaking machine! Let me help too!

Surprised, Kikaider? This is just a little hello, my calling card. I am Hakaider, DARK's warrior of evil!

As long as I'm around… there's no escape for you, no matter what you do! Your life is mine!
Ngh…
Ngh…

Don't underestimate me, Kikaider! This Hakaider Shot is no ordinary gun!

Take a hit from its high-frequency rounds, and any machine at all will be destroyed.
Damn…
Damn…

Heh heh heh… Kikaider? Your arm's been hit, so you can't move, can you?

I hate looking at weaklings! Die!!
Tooh…
Tooh…
That's more like it, Kikaider! You'll be worth killing!

Ngh… Oh no!?

My left arm was hit, and my lubricating oil is draining out! My body's going to stop moving.

Ngh… Oh no!?

My left arm was hit, and my lubricating oil is draining out! My body's going to stop moving.

Ugh, damn it!?

Kikaider! The next time we meet… I'll take your life, without fail!
Ugh… M-Mari…e…
…!? Daisaku!!
…!? Daisaku!!
J-Jiro!!
Professor Gill! Hakaider's blood exchange is complete!

Mm… This is Hakaider's one and only weak point!

If his blood isn't exchanged with the blood from Komyoji's brain within a set time, Hakaider will die…

And after driving Kikaider that far into a corner… Kaimen Green!
You called, Professor Gill…?

Kikaider… can't use his left arm right now! Don't let this chance slip by!!

Use the Mitsuko and Masaru siblings to lure Kikaider out!
My… Mitsuko, you have a terrible sense of direction, don't you?
Yes… But I'm sure it's somewhere around here. Mr. Tachibana's shop…
Hanpen… Are you sure you're not lost?

Now, now, Masaru… I am not Hanpen, but Han-pei!

Hanpei Hattori, the greatest detective of the 20th century! Kindly remember that!
Huh?
Wh-what is it… Y-y-you want a piece of me? Huh!?
Hey… Mitsuko, Masaru. And you must be Hanpen?
Who are you?
How do you know who we are?

Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey! You're not human, are you? You're an android…!?

Y-you're a DARK robot, aren't you?
Calm down! I'm Jiro's younger brother… Saburo!
Saburo?
Jiro's younger brother!?
When Jiro's body broke down… my body was designed to wake from its long sleep… automatically!
Then Jiro's been hurt!? And… you're an android Father built too?
Show us proof!

Actually, I… was just about to say that myself!

Something… show us a commuter pass, or an ID card… okay?
Look out!
Aaah…
You two siblings are coming with us to the DARK base!
Kaimen Green… I won't let you do that!!
What!? I see… So you mean to get in our way? You go first!

uncertain: U01849: 39カ国に精通した語学の天才 rendered 'knows 39 countries' languages inside out'
U01862: 軟体怪獣イカゲラス romanized 'Ikagerasu' (not in glossary)
U01884: speaker label is DARK Robot, but the line is Hakaider introducing himself
U01897: マリーち…ゃん rendered 'Mari…e…' (name broken by pain)
U01907/U01908/U01911: Masaru's nickname Hanpen (a fishcake pun on Hanpei) kept as 'Hanpen'
U01915/U01918: Saburo claims to be Jiro's brother (Hakaider's human form per glossary); translated at face value
